subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supplier Sustainability Scorecards
description: A micro-lesson that makes Supplier Sustainability Scorecards usable.

hook.text: You rate your suppliers on cost and quality. But do you rate them on emissions, water use, and labor practices?

buildup.text: Sustainability scorecards evaluate suppliers on environmental and social performance alongside business metrics.

discovery.text: Metrics include carbon emissions, waste generation, water usage, safety records, and diversity performance.

twist.text: Many suppliers lack the data or capability to report sustainability metrics. Support and training help close the gap.

climax.text: Walmart's Project Gigaton asks suppliers to collectively reduce 1 billion tons of emissions by 2030.

punchline.text: Measure sustainability like you measure cost. It matters as much.

quiz.question: What is Walmart's Project Gigaton?
options: A supplier initiative to reduce 1 billion tons of emissions
